verdict.rationale: Riskified supports sending automated decision notifications to a merchant-defined endpoint (a webhook-like push mechanism) for order approve/decline events, with retry logic on non-2xx responses, but this is a single fixed notification channel tied to order decisions rather than a general-purpose event subscription system with selectable event types or topics. Missing for 10: documentation of a formal webhook subscription API (event types, subscribe/unsubscribe endpoints, multiple event categories beyond order decisions), and independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability.
